quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to return your playthings to their proper shelf or bin"?
quests.question: Put Away Your Toys
quests.hint: Bins, shelves, or toy boxes are where these end up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put away our toys so each one has its own spot.
quests.funFact: Giving every toy its own special spot makes clean-up time much quicker!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to scrub plates and cups clean after a meal"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a sponge are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash the dishes after a meal to keep them clean.
quests.funFact: Washing dishes right after a meal makes the food much easier to clean off!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to carry plates and cups away after everyone finishes eating"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: This happens right after a meal is finished, not before.
quests.explanation: Yes! We clear the table once everyone has finished eating.
quests.funFact: Clearing the table is a helpful way to pitch in after a family meal!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to decide what shirt and pants to wear today"?
quests.question: Choose Your Clothes
quests.hint: You look in your closet or drawer for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We choose our clothes in the morning before getting dressed.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather can help you choose whether to pick shorts or a warm sweater!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to brush crumbs and dust into a tidy pile"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: A broom with long bristles helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We sweep the floor to clear away dust and crumbs.
quests.funFact: Sweeping right after a meal can help keep crumbs from spreading around the house!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to neatly stack clean clothes after they dry"?
quests.question: Fold the Laundry
quests.hint: Clean, dry clothes are turned into neat stacks for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We fold the laundry to turn clean clothes into neat stacks.
quests.funFact: Folding laundry as a family can make the chore go by much faster!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to clear away dust and crumbs with a broom"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: Dust and crumbs are gathered into a small pile for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Sweeping means using a broom to gather dust into a pile.
quests.funFact: A broom's long bristles can reach into corners that are hard to clean!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to store your toys neatly before bedtime"?
quests.question: Put Away Your Toys
quests.hint: You do this once playtime is completely finished.
quests.explanation: That's right! Putting away toys means placing each one back where it belongs.
quests.funFact: A tidy toy shelf can help you find your favorite toy again in no time!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to rinse away food from plates and bowls"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: You do this after a meal, not before.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing dishes means scrubbing plates and cups until they sparkle.
quests.funFact: Some families take turns washing the dishes to help each other out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to pick an outfit that matches the weather outside"?
quests.question: Choose Your Clothes
quests.hint: This happens before you actually put your clothes on.
quests.explanation: That's right! Choosing clothes means picking an outfit that fits the day.
quests.funFact: Picking your clothes the night before can make your morning much quicker!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to smooth and stack shirts once they're clean and dry"?
quests.question: Fold the Laundry
quests.hint: This happens after clothes come out of the dryer or off the line.
quests.explanation: That's right! Folding laundry means smoothing and stacking clean clothes neatly.
quests.funFact: Neatly folded clothes take up less space in a drawer or closet!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to remove empty dishes once the meal is finished"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: Empty plates and cups get carried away for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Clearing the table means carrying away the empty plates and cups.
quests.funFact: Setting and clearing the table are two halves of the very same mealtime routine!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to place each toy back where it belongs"?
quests.question: Put Away Your Toys
quests.hint: Each toy has its very own special spot for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy toy shelf makes it easy to find toys again tomorrow.
quests.funFact: Giving every toy its own special spot makes clean-up time much quicker!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to make the floor neat and free of crumbs"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: This leaves the floor looking neat and clean.
quests.explanation: Well done! A swept floor looks neat and feels clean under your feet.
quests.funFact: Sweeping right after a meal can help keep crumbs from spreading around the house!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to tidy the table once dinner is all done"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: This is the opposite of setting the table.
quests.explanation: Well done! A cleared table is ready to be wiped clean.
quests.funFact: Clearing the table is a helpful way to pitch in after a family meal!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to clean up plates and cups after dinner"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: Plates and cups become sparkly clean because of this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Clean dishes are ready to use again at the next meal.
quests.funFact: Washing dishes right after a meal makes the food much easier to clean off!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to turn a pile of clean clothes into neat stacks"?
quests.question: Fold the Laundry
quests.hint: Shirts, socks, and pants all get neatly stacked for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Neatly folded clothes are easy to put away in a drawer.
quests.funFact: Folding laundry as a family can make the chore go by much faster!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to look through your closet and pick something to wear"?
quests.question: Choose Your Clothes
quests.hint: The weather outside can help you decide what to pick.
quests.explanation: Well done! Picking the right outfit can depend on the weather outside.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather can help you choose whether to pick shorts or a warm sweater!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to check you have books and pencils before you leave"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You carry this on your back all the way to school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing our backpack means gathering books and supplies for the day.
quests.funFact: A backpack with both straps on your shoulders is comfier to carry all day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to share a warm greeting as the day begins"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: This is the opposite of the words we use at bedtime.
quests.explanation: Well done! A friendly good morning can make everyone feel happy.
quests.funFact: People around the world greet each other every morning in their own special way!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to gather up plates once everyone is finished eating"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: This happens right after a meal is finished, not before.
quests.explanation: Yes! We clear the table once everyone has finished eating.
quests.funFact: Setting and clearing the table are two halves of the very same mealtime routine!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to place your jacket on a hook or hanger"?
quests.question: Hang Up Clothes
quests.hint: You do this after you change out of your daytime clothes.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy closet starts with hanging up our clothes.
quests.funFact: A tidy closet makes it much easier to pick an outfit in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to tidy your blankets and pillow after waking up"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: It leaves your bed looking neat, ready for bedtime again later.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy bed helps our whole room feel neat and calm.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to gather dust into a pile before it gets tracked around"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: A broom with long bristles helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We sweep the floor to clear away dust and crumbs.
quests.funFact: A broom's long bristles can reach into corners that are hard to clean!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to help get everything ready before the family eats"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: You do this right before a meal begins, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Setting the table means placing plates and forks before a meal.
quests.funFact: Some families like to fold napkins into fun shapes when setting the table!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to splash in warm water and get squeaky clean"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: A rubber duck might float along while you do this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Taking a bath gets us squeaky clean from head to toe.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to tidy up after a fun afternoon of play"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: It leaves your floor clear and your room looking tidy.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy playroom is ready for more fun tomorrow.
quests.funFact: A tidy playroom gives you more space to run, build, and play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to straighten up your whole room before bed"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: A neat, calm room is the result of this task.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy room helps us feel calm and ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Tidying up a little bit each day keeps a big mess from building up!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to relax quietly with a good book"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: Pages, pictures, and a good story are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We read a book in the evening to relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Reading before bed can help your mind relax and get ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to snuggle under the covers and rest"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: Your eyes get heavy and sleepy right before this happens.
quests.explanation: Correct! We go to bed at night so we can wake up ready for a new day.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!
